verdict.rationale: Bland is a voice AI calling platform, so per-call recording controls and data retention are a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents recording toggles, consent or disclosure prompts, or retention settings. The llms.txt mention of 'regulated' workflows and the dedicated enterprise infrastructure are generic or adjacent claims and do not show these controls exist.

support.subject: As a founder, I can meet call-recording consent and disclosure obligations with per-call recording controls and configurable data retention
